description: The chart titled “QA-2” illustrates the distribution of response outcomes across two systems using horizontal stacked bars segmented into three categories: Correct, Partially Correct, and Incorrect. The category axis is vertical, showing two unlabeled rows (top) and “RedWhale (our)” (bottom), with no apparent sorting beyond this displayed order. The value axis is horizontal and not explicitly labeled; values are presented as percentages within each stacked segment, and each bar visually represents a full 100% total. For the top row, the stacked bar consists of a dark purple “Correct” segment labeled 92.9, a medium blue “Partially Correct” segment labeled 2.9, and a light blue “Incorrect” segment labeled 4.3. For “RedWhale (our),” the stacked bar consists of a dark purple “Correct” segment labeled 95.7, a medium blue “Partially Correct” segment labeled 1.4, and a light blue “Incorrect” segment labeled 2.9. A legend at the bottom maps dark purple to Correct, medium blue to Partially Correct, and light blue to Incorrect, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the internal numeric annotations.
